title: Reassign lead technician lists eligible technicians and Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Three eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard", [Tech-B] "Ralph Edwards", [Tech-C] "Dana Ortiz". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Three staff members who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user "Owen Office", a technician whose staff record is set to Inactive "Ivan Inactive", and a technician enrolled only at another location "Lena Otherloc".
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Reassign List" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A].
  • The six staff names are used in the expected results and stay as written; the work order number is an example.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-C] = "Dana Ortiz" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. Three staff members who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user ("Owen Office"), a technician whose staff record you set to Inactive ("Ivan Inactive"), and a technician enrolled only at another location ("Lena Otherloc"). Create them the same way under Settings > Staff.
  5. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Reassign List" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  6. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Reassign List": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Reassign List" shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician [Tech-A]; Settings > Staff shows Owen Office with an Office role, Ivan Inactive as inactive and Lena Otherloc at the other location only. If not, fix it on the work order page before starting; then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Reassign List" in Search.
  3. Hover [WO-1]'s card in [Tech-A]'s column and click its More actions (…) button.
  4. Choose Reassign lead technician.
  5. Read every choice listed in the dialog.
  6. Pick [Tech-B] and confirm the dialog with its confirm button (e.g. "Reassign").
  7. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  8. Open the same card's More actions menu again and choose Reassign lead technician.
  9. Pick Unassigned and confirm.
  10. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  11. Open the card's More actions menu again (it is now in the Unassigned column) and choose Reassign lead technician.
  12. Pick [Tech-C], then click Cancel.
  13. Open the work order (click the card) and read Lead Technician.
  14. Go back, pick Tech View in the display switcher and repeat steps 3 to 13 using the row's More actions button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card's More actions menu (and the Tech View row's) offers Reassign lead technician, and choosing it opens the Reassign lead technician dialog.
  • The dialog lists Unassigned and the eligible technicians of this location, e.g. Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz. Owen Office, Ivan Inactive and Lena Otherloc are not listed.
  • After picking Ralph Edwards and confirming, the card is in Ralph Edwards' column (the row in his group), and the work order page shows Lead Technician Ralph Edwards. After picking Unassigned and confirming, the card is in the Unassigned column and the work order has no lead technician.
  • After Cancel, nothing changes: the card stays in Unassigned and the work order still has no lead technician.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R4, S4-R12, S4-R13, S4-R14, read 8 Oct 2026. Eligibility from PRD §5 Terminology (Technician) and S2-R7. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): card and row More actions (…) button and the reassign dialog (title "Reassign Lead Tech", search "Search technicians", Cancel). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the Reassign lead technician dialog.”
  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and Unassigned.”
  • S4-R13: “Confirming the dialog changes the lead to the selected technician or Unassigned.”
  • S4-R14: “Canceling the dialog leaves the lead unchanged.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
